name: Buckle Up
summary: A seatbelt lock toggle: the tongue clicks into the buckle and drive mode tucks your messages away
about: A drive mode switch drawn as a real seatbelt on a car seat. Buckling pulls the metal tongue back a touch, slides it into the buckle with a click, turns the dashboard light from blinking red to green and snaps the orange webbing tight, while the notifications are swept into a held-for-later pill. New messages keep arriving every few seconds and get held too, with an optional auto-reply; unbuckling springs the tongue out and drops every message back.
how: Press the buckle (or Tab to it and press Space) to buckle up and turn drive mode on.
Watch new messages peek in and get tucked into the held pill while you drive.
Turn the auto-reply switch on or off to choose whether senders get a reply.
Press the buckle again to unbuckle; the held messages drop back into the list.
